name: Daganzo de Arriba (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Daganzo de Arriba (a tower on green and a sword and bars on red, with the words AVE MARIA).
history: Municipal flag of Daganzo de Arriba; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Daganzo de Arriba arms — tower on green, sword and bars on red, with the words AVE MARIA
